choices.text: Cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></semantics></math> thì giá trị của <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><msqrt><mi>a</mi></msqrt></msub><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

Cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></semantics></math> thỏa <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mi>a</mi></msub><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></semantics></math> thì <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mi>a</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

Cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></semantics></math> thỏa <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mi>a</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></semantics></math> thì ta được <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>2024</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2025</mn></msup><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mn>2025</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow></semantics></math>

Cho các số thực dương <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>x</mi></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>y</mi></semantics></math> thì <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mn>2</mn></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mn>2</mn></msub><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><msub><mo>log</mo><mn>2</mn></msub><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></semantics></math>

solution:
1. Ta có loga(a2b)=logaa2+logab=2+2=4.
  2. Theo quy tắc tính lôgarit thì với a là số thực dương khác 1 và x và y là các số thực dương, ta có
    log2(xy)=log2x−log2y.
  3. logaa=loga12a=2.
  4. Từ loga(a2b)=4⇒logab=2.
    Khi đó loga2(a−2024b2025)=loga2a−2024+loga2b2025=−20242+20252⋅2=1013.
